chunks.title: Electrical Shock and Fire Hazards
chunks.content: Never immerse cord, plug, or appliance in water; disconnect and inspect if cord/plug is damaged; only use grounded outlets and never modify the plug.

steps: Return it to the Nespresso Club or an authorized representative
Never immerse cord, plug, or appliance in water or other liquid
Never touch the cord with wet hands
Keep the appliance away from water splashes and humidity

chunks.title: Scalding Hazard from Hot Liquids and Capsules
chunks.content: Never force open the machine during operation as hot liquid and coffee grounds may splash; if a capsule is blocked, turn off and unplug the machine before touching it.

scenarios.condition: Capsule is blocked in the compartment
steps: Call the Nespresso Club or an authorized representative for assistance
Do not attempt to force the machine open

chunks.title: Child and Vulnerable-User Supervision
chunks.content: Children under 8 must not use, clean, or maintain the appliance unsupervised, and children should never play with or use the machine unattended; keep appliance, cord, and capsules out of children's reach.

chunks.title: Do Not Open, Dismantle, or Modify the Machine
chunks.content: Never open or dismantle the appliance due to hazardous internal voltage; only authorized service representatives should perform repairs beyond routine cleaning.

chunks.title: Never Use Damaged Capsules or Non-Approved Liquids
chunks.content: Only use fresh, undamaged Nespresso Vertuo capsules and fill the tank only with fresh drinking water — never milk or flavored liquids — to avoid damaging the machine.

chunks.title: No Steam Cleaners, Dishwasher, or Harsh Chemicals
chunks.content: Never use a steam or pressure cleaner, strong solvents, or place the machine or its parts in a dishwasher; clean only with a damp cloth and mild agent.

chunks.title: Machine Specifications
Overview of Machine Parts
chunks.content: Key parts include coffee outlet, adjustable cup support, water tank, adjustable water tank arm, lid, OFF/open-close lever, ON/coffee button, and capsule container.

chunks.title: Move Water Tank and Capsule Container
chunks.content: The water tank arm rotates to back, left, or right; remove the tank by tilting back and lifting, reinsert vertically until it clicks. The capsule container slides sideways into place at the rear of the machine, held by a magnet.

chunks.title: Adjust Cup Support and Power Cable
chunks.content: The cup support has 4 positions and can be removed for larger cups by sliding it into the holes and pressing down until hooks engage; the power cable can be routed under the machine to the left or right side depending on tank position.

chunks.title: First Use or After Long Non-Use
chunks.content: Rinse and fill the water tank, ensure capsule container and cup support are in place, plug in, and turn on; the green light blinks while heating (about 25 sec) then becomes steady when ready. Then place a container, eject any capsule, and run the initial cleaning cycle (press button 3 times within 2 seconds) which takes up to 5 minutes.

chunks.title: Prepare a Coffee
chunks.content: Fill tank, turn on machine, wait for steady green light, place cup, open head, insert capsule dome-down, close head, and press button to start brewing; press again to stop early. Factory cup sizes are Alto 14 fl oz, Coffee 7.77 fl oz, Espresso 1.35 fl oz.

chunks.title: Manually Adjust Coffee Volume and Eject Capsule
chunks.content: Press the button again during brewing to manually top off coffee to desired volume; to eject the capsule, open the machine head by pushing the lever up.

chunks.title: Energy Saving / Auto Shutoff
chunks.content: The machine can be turned off manually by closing the head and holding the lever down for 3 seconds; it also automatically shuts off after 9 minutes of non-use.

chunks.title: Program Water Volume per Capsule Size
chunks.content: Programming is specific to Espresso, Coffee, or Alto capsule sizes; insert the capsule, close head, hold the button until desired volume is reached, and the new volume is saved for that capsule size (range 0.3-17 fl oz).

chunks.title: Run the Cleaning Cycle
chunks.content: Rinse tank and cup support, eject used capsule, then press the button 3 times within 2 seconds to start an automatic 3-cycle internal cleaning process lasting up to 5 minutes.

chunks.title: Reset to Factory Settings
chunks.content: Turn machine off, enter Special Functions by holding button and lever down together for 3 seconds, press lever down 3 times to select reset, then press the button to confirm; orange light blinks 3 times then turns steady green.

chunks.title: Empty the System Before Non-Use, Frost, or Repair
chunks.content: Empty water tank and capsule container, enter Special Functions mode, select 'Emptying the system' (press lever down twice), then push the button; the machine evacuates remaining liquid using heat and shuts off automatically when done.

chunks.title: Descale the Machine
chunks.content: Eject capsule, empty cup support and capsule container, fill tank with 1 unit of Nespresso descaling liquid plus at least 17 fl oz water, enter Special Functions, select Descaling (press lever once), place a large container, and press button to start; process takes about 20 minutes including a rinse phase.

Descaling alert (half green/half red steady light) means the machine can brew only a few more times before descaling becomes mandatory; if fully scaled, pause the program for several minutes to let descaler penetrate then restart.

chunks.title: Packaging Contents
Descaling Solution Handling Safety
chunks.content: The descaling solution can be harmful; avoid contact with eyes, skin, and surfaces, and use only genuine Nespresso descaling kits to avoid damaging the machine.

chunks.title: Steam Emission During System Emptying
chunks.content: When emptying the system the machine evacuates liquid using heat and may emit small amounts of steam, so caution is advised near the outlet.

tasks.title: Run the Machine Cleaning Cycle
tasks.description: Run the built-in automatic cleaning cycle to flush and clean the internal water pathway.
tasks.justification: Prevents residue buildup and coffee grounds appearing in the cup; keeps internal pathways clear for consistent brewing.
tasks.instructions_text: Rinse the water tank and refill with fresh water, empty and rinse the cup support, eject the used capsule and empty the capsule container. Place a container under the outlet, then press the button 3 times within 2 seconds to start the automatic cleaning cycle, which runs 3 pump/clean/flow cycles over about 5 minutes.

tasks.title: Descale the Machine
tasks.description: Run the descaling program using Nespresso descaling solution to remove mineral scale buildup.
tasks.justification: Scale buildup reduces heating efficiency and can eventually stop the machine from functioning; manual requires descaling once the alert appears.
tasks.instructions_text: Eject any capsule, empty the cup support and capsule container, then fill the water tank with 1 unit of Nespresso descaling liquid plus at least 17 fl oz of water. Enter Special Functions (hold button + lever down 3 sec), select Descaling (press lever once), place a container of at least 20 fl oz under the outlet, and press the button to run the full ~20 minute descale-and-rinse program. Afterward, empty and rinse the tank and cup support, refill with fresh water, and let the machine dry 10 minutes before use.

tasks.title: Empty the System Before Storage or Repair
tasks.description: Run the emptying function to evacuate all water from the machine before a period of non-use, freezing temperatures, or a repair.
tasks.justification: Leaving water inside the machine risks freeze damage during cold storage and is required before servicing.
tasks.instructions_text: Empty the water tank and capsule container, then turn the machine off. Place a container under the outlet, enter Special Functions (hold button + lever down 3 sec), press the lever down twice to select 'Emptying the system,' then press the button; the machine will evacuate remaining water using heat and shut off automatically when finished.

tasks.title: Clean the Capsule Container
tasks.description: Empty and rinse the used-capsule collection container.
tasks.justification: Prevents coffee residue buildup and odor from accumulated used capsules.
tasks.instructions_text: Slide the capsule container out of the machine, empty out the used capsules, and rinse the container before sliding it back into place.

tasks.title: Clean the Cup Support and Water Tank
tasks.description: Rinse and clean the cup support, water tank, and lid regularly.
tasks.justification: Cosmetic and hygienic upkeep — prevents residue and staining on surfaces that contact water and drips.
tasks.instructions_text: Remove the cup support and water tank/lid, rinse them with water and a mild cleaning agent using a damp cloth, then dry and reassemble.

tasks.title: Wipe the Coffee Outlet and Exterior
tasks.description: Wipe the coffee outlet and machine exterior with a damp cloth regularly.
tasks.justification: Cosmetic maintenance — keeps coffee drips and residue from building up on visible surfaces.
tasks.instructions_text: Use a damp cloth with a mild cleaning agent to wipe the coffee outlet and outer surfaces of the machine.

tasks.title: Position Water Tank Arm and Power Cable
tasks.description: Set the water tank arm to the desired side (back, left, or right) and route the power cable accordingly during setup.
tasks.justification: Correct setup ensures stable operation and prevents cable strain or the machine tipping when moving the tank.
tasks.instructions_text: Rotate the water tank arm to the back, left, or right position as desired. Route the excess power cable under the machine into the guide on the corresponding side, ensuring the machine remains upright.

re_check_triggers.description: Machine tips or feels unstable after repositioning the water tank arm

tasks.title: Perform First-Use Rinse and Initial Cleaning Cycle
tasks.description: Before first use or after a long period of non-use, rinse the tank and run the initial automatic cleaning cycle.
tasks.justification: Clears any manufacturing residue or stagnant water from the internal system before brewing the first coffee.
tasks.instructions_text: Rinse and fill the water tank with fresh drinking water, ensure the capsule container and cup support are in place, plug in and power on the machine, and wait for the steady green ready light. Place a container of at least 27 fl oz under the outlet, eject any capsule, then press the button 3 times within 2 seconds to run the automatic cleaning cycle (up to 5 minutes).

deep_clean.title: Cleaning Cycle and Descaling
steps: Rinse water tank, cup support, and capsule container
Fill tank with fresh water (or descaling solution for descaling)
Eject any used capsule and place a container under the outlet
Enter the cleaning or descaling cycle via the button/lever sequence and let it run automatically
Rinse and refill tank with fresh water after descaling and let the machine dry before use
